cards.name: FEVER
cards.text: While it is in your hand your grip is wrong. Everything you swing is one harder to land.

cards.name: TUNNEL VISION
cards.text: While it is in your hand you cannot filter what you hear. Listening takes twice as long.

cards.name: COLD SWEAT
cards.text: While it is in your hand you are clumsy. Everything you do that makes a sound makes one more.

cards.name: TREMOR
cards.text: While it is in your hand you cannot hold still. Creeping is as loud as walking.

cards.name: BLACKOUT
cards.text: The moment it comes to hand your vision goes and you put a hand through something.

cards.name: BYPASS
cards.text: Shunt the reserve cells. Two more power in the pool.

cards.name: BRACE
cards.text: Set yourself. The next thing that reaches you this hour does not land.

cards.name: REROUTE
cards.text: Take the maintenance run. One compartment over, and quietly.

cards.name: SCRAP CHARGE
cards.text: Lob a handful of couplings down a corridor. Pick any compartment: it gets loud, and everything that can hear it goes there instead of here.

cards.name: CUTTING TORCH
cards.text: Cut it open. +2 against whatever is in reach.

cards.name: HARDLINE
cards.text: Bridge the bus by hand. The reactor gives one more an hour.

cards.name: FIELD REPAIR
cards.text: Strip and reload a weapon, wherever you are standing.

cards.name: STEADY HANDS
cards.text: Work the problem. Two more things come to hand.

cards.name: CIRCUIT MAP
cards.text: Pull up the deck plan and read what is moving on it. Everything within three compartments shows itself.

cards.name: SLAG THE DOOR
cards.text: Weld the frame while it is still on the other side. Everything next door stays where it is for two hours.

cards.name: OVERRIDE
cards.text: Drop a bulkhead anywhere on the ship for three hours.

cards.name: LOAD-SHED
cards.text: Kill every non-essential circuit. The whole ship falls silent at once.

cards.name: SUPPRESS
cards.text: Short bursts, centre mass. +1 against whatever is in reach.

cards.name: HOLD THE LINE
cards.text: Back to the bulkhead, weapon up. The next thing that reaches you this hour does not land.

cards.name: FLASHBANG
cards.text: Throw it long. Pick any compartment: it goes loud, and everything that can hear it turns and goes there.

cards.name: PUSH
cards.text: Put your shoulder into it and drive it into the next compartment.

cards.name: SIDEARM
cards.text: Standard issue. +1 against whatever is in reach.

cards.name: BREACHING GUN
cards.text: One shell, close. +3 against whatever is in reach.

cards.name: BREACHING CHARGE
cards.text: Set it against whatever is in the room and walk backwards. Whatever it was, it is not any more.

cards.name: DOOR CHARGE
cards.text: Blow the frame. One way out of this compartment is shut for three hours.

cards.name: SWEEP
cards.text: Work the corners with the tracker. Everything within three compartments shows itself.

cards.name: ADRENALINE
cards.text: You find another minute inside the hour.

cards.name: LAST STAND
cards.text: Take the doorway and hold it. Nothing in this compartment moves for three hours.

cards.name: TRIAGE
cards.text: Work it out of yourself while you still can. One infection leaves your deck for good.

cards.name: FIELD DRESSING
cards.text: Pack it and tape it. The next thing that reaches you this hour does not land.

cards.name: STEADY
cards.text: Count it down. Two more things come to hand.

cards.name: QUIET STEP
cards.text: One compartment over, without a sound.

cards.name: VITALS
cards.text: Read the compartment monitors. Everything within three compartments shows itself.

cards.name: ANTISEPTIC
cards.text: It burns going in. One infection leaves your deck, and something comes to hand.

cards.name: SCALPEL
cards.text: It is not a weapon and you are not a fighter. Nothing added to the swing.

cards.name: SEDATIVE
cards.text: Put yourself most of the way under and let the machine work. Two infections leave your deck.

cards.name: MORPHINE
cards.text: You will feel it later. The next two things that reach you this hour do not land.

cards.name: BLOOD WORK
cards.text: A full exchange, on a table, with something aboard. Two infections leave your deck.

cards.name: CAREFUL STEP
cards.text: One compartment over, without a sound.

cards.name: DUCT MAP
cards.text: You have been in the ducts. Everything within four compartments shows itself.

cards.name: CACHE
cards.text: You know where the crew hid things. Search this compartment.

cards.name: MARKER FLARE
cards.text: Pop it down a corridor. Pick any compartment: it goes loud, and everything that can hear it goes there.

cards.name: HAND OFF
cards.text: Two more things come to hand.

cards.name: PRY BAR
cards.text: It is a tool and you use it like one. +1 against whatever is in reach.

cards.name: WEDGE
cards.text: Jam the runner. One way out of this compartment is shut for two hours.

cards.name: STILL
cards.text: Stop. Breathe out. The compartment goes quiet and nothing lands on you this hour.

cards.name: SPRINT
cards.text: You find another minute inside the hour, and everything hears you find it.

cards.name: RAPPEL
cards.text: Down a shaft you already know. Come out at any vent on the ship.

cards.name: COURSE CORRECT
cards.text: Trim the reserve draw. One more power in the pool.

cards.name: PREFLIGHT
cards.text: You know the sequence by heart. Two straight into the shuttle, wherever you are standing.

cards.name: NERVE
cards.text: One more thing comes to hand.

cards.name: TRIM
cards.text: One compartment over, without a sound.

cards.name: HARNESS
cards.text: Strap in against the frame. The next thing that reaches you this hour does not land.

cards.name: SIGNAL CHECK
cards.text: Sweep the internal net. Everything within three compartments shows itself.

cards.name: CONTROL STICK
cards.text: You tore it off the console. +1 against whatever is in reach.

cards.name: BOOST
cards.text: Overfill the cells and hope the line holds. Four straight into the shuttle.

cards.name: DEADSTICK
cards.text: Run the whole ship off the emergency bus for an hour. Three power in the pool.

cards.name: MAYDAY
cards.text: Open every channel on the ship at once. Pick any compartment: everything aboard that can hear goes to it.

cards.name: POWER CELLS
cards.text: Three power, still in the cells.

cards.name: SALVAGED SIDEARM
cards.text: Somebody dropped it running. +1 against whatever is in reach.

cards.name: SCRAP FLARE
cards.text: A signal flare with the cap already off. Pick any compartment: it goes loud and pulls whatever can hear it.

cards.name: FIELD KIT
cards.text: Somebody's kit, unopened. One infection leaves your deck.

cards.name: STIMULANT AMPOULE
cards.text: One infection leaves your deck.

cards.name: RATION TIN
cards.text: Cold, and the best thing that has happened all day. A minute back, and something to hand.

cards.name: SEALED CORPSE
cards.text: Strip the suit. Four power, and something gets on you.

cards.name: JAMMED DOOR
cards.text: It will not stay shut, and it bangs.

cards.name: PERSONAL LOG
cards.text: Somebody's last entry. Worth reading, and worth filing.
